dct_description_sm: Plow routes for streets in Kingston are classified as Arterial, Collector and transit routes, and Residential, each having different objectives. For general information about snow plowing in the City of Kingston, visit https://www.cityofkingston.ca/residents/roads-and-traffic/snow-removal.
